introHtml: LED light headwear combines headwear with built-in lighting for enhanced visibility in low-light conditions. Safety managers choose these for night crews or event staff, while marketing directors use them for memorable giveaways at evening runs or concerts. Decoration options include screen printing or embroidery on the fabric panels, with the LED feature adding practical value that keeps your brand seen after dark.
